title: Kissed with Herbs Greek Goat Bamboo Steamer Moussaka
description: A fresh, springy, and energizing Greek dish featuring goat meat, double-rise bread, and a paleo-friendly twist in a bamboo steamer moussaka format.

ingredients.name: 1 cup grated feta (dairy-free alternative recommended for paleo diet)

instructions: Preheat a bamboo steamer over boiling water.
Season the goat meat with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet and cook the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook until they start to break down.
Add the dried oregano and thyme, and stir to combine.
Add the chopped goat meat and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as needed.
Transfer the meat mixture to a separate dish and set aside.
Brush the slices of double-rise bread with olive oil and toast until crispy, breaking them into crumbs.
In a separate pot of boiling water, blanch the chopped parsley and dill for 1-2 minutes to preserve their color and texture.
Drain the herbs and chop them finely.
To assemble the moussaka, layer the meat mixture, croutons, and blanched herbs in the bamboo steamer.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve hot.
Garnish with additional parsley and dill, if desired.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
